changelog.notes: 1.0.0 First version: log, history, insights, encrypted two-phone sync, PDF export, backups, Supplement area, remembered medicines and supplements, Log this again.
1.0.1 Description is optional when an entry has a medicine or supplement, a temperature or notes.

1.1.0 Blood test area: results with units and normal ranges from the report, low/high flags, remembered ranges, trend charts in Insights, iron supplement counts between tests, blood test table and charts in the PDF.

1.2.0 Overnight sleep: Sleep entries logged in the evening default to the time they went to sleep and in the morning to the wake-up time; nights are paired into hours slept with averages, a 14-night chart with the Australian guideline band, night wakings, a short-night pattern, a sleep table in the PDF, and a sleep guideline setting.
1.2.1 One-tap "Log a night wake-up now" under Sleep (3–5 min, current time, undo). Night wake-ups are a sleep type with minutes awake, taken off the night total.
1.2.2 Concern level is optional for every entry; tap the chosen level again to clear it.

1.3.0 Supplements and medicines can list what's in them (ingredient and strength), saved with the product so the remembered button fills them in; iron inside a product counts towards the ferritin iron note; shown in History, search, PDF and text export.

1.4.0 Ready-made PediaSure Vanilla (powder) under Supplement: published Abbott AU nutrition panel (per 100 mL), scoops stepper with 5 scoops = 225 mL standard serve, nutrients scale with scoops; remembered with scoop count; its iron counts towards the ferritin note.

1.5.0 Exact time on every entry: next to the date, prefilled with now, editable later; time of day follows it automatically (picker shown only when there is no exact time); an automatic time is cleared when logging an earlier day; History, PDF and text show the exact time.

1.6.0 Choose several supplements (or medicines) from Used before and save them together: each becomes its own entry with the shared date, time and notes; amounts and scoops editable per item; one undo for the group.

1.7.0 Supplement check: daily totals of logged supplements and medicines against Australia's NRV upper levels for the chosen age group (1-3, 4-8, 9-13), warnings at 80% and 100%; iron within 2 hours of calcium/milk/PediaSure or zinc; vitamin C tip with iron; uncounted items listed; shown live in the form, as a flag on History days and as an Insights card; age group setting.

1.8.0 Shorter History: supplements or medicines given within 15 minutes of each other, and a night's wake-ups, show as one line that opens to show each entry, with "Log these again". Who logged an entry moves onto its top line, so most cards are a line shorter; notes show three lines.

1.8.1 Nature's Way Kids Smart Vita Gummies Multi-Vitamin for Fussy Eaters added as a ready-made supplement: ingredients per gummy from the label, counted in gummies, defaulting to the label dose for the age group (1 for ages 1–3, 2 otherwise), and included in the supplement check. Ready-made chips stay visible in the product form so you can switch between products. Amounts under 1 show three decimals.

1.9.0 Family members: parents set up a separate private family storage (with a key that can't reach the main storage) and add people such as Grandma, each with their own code and encryption key. Family members choose Join as family, get Log and History only, and see only what they log. Their entries appear in the parents' log tagged with their name; parents' phones only accept each person's changes to their own entries, skip anything that can't be unlocked, and ignore removed people. History groups only combine entries from the same person.

1.10.0 Time tab: a private record of the time you spend caring for your child. Start and stop a timer, or add time afterwards, by type; totals, daily average and a breakdown for 7, 30 or 90 days; edit, delete and CSV export. Stored only on the phone it is logged on: never synced, never shared with a partner or family member, and included in backup files.

1.10.1 The log form moves to the current date and time when you reopen the app (if you haven't changed it), and a date or time you pick is always the one saved, including on iPhone when you save straight after picking.

1.11.0 How did today feel? One tap a day on the Log tab (calm and easy, mostly fine, bumpy, hard), a screen to rate recent days, and a Sleep and how days felt card in Insights that compares your easiest stretch with the last 14 days.

1.12.0 Height & weight area: log height (cm) and weight (kg) with the date, see both over time in Insights with the change since the last measurement, and include them in History, the PDF and the copied report.

1.13.0 Today's outlook on the Log tab: when last night's sleep was short, there were night wake-ups, yesterday was rated bumpy or hard, or food hasn't been logged, a short heads-up lists its reasons and a couple of ideas. It can be hidden for the day or turned off in Settings.

1.14.0 Growth percentiles: add your child's sex and birth month and year in Settings to see where height, weight and BMI sit for their age (WHO standards to 2 years, CDC charts from 2 years), with a 3rd to 97th percentile band on the charts and a gentle note when a measurement has moved a lot. Worked out on the phone.

1.15.0 'What did today look like?' taps on the daily card (outdoors, active play, one-on-one time, calm morning, bedtime routine, low screen, unwell, routine changed, busy, big day). Insights shows which taps go with calmer days; the today banner notes unwell and routine-change days, and a missing one-on-one time reminder in the evening.

1.16.0 People who help: add your partner, carers and family in Settings (shared with everyone). Pick them as 'who' when logging. In the private Time tab, choose who did the care (timer, add time, edit); Time shows who looked after your child, with share of time and kinds of care, and the CSV has a Who column. Time stays only on this phone.

1.17.0 Outdoors and active play: quick minutes (+10, +30, +60, Other), a timer, or a start and end time, with who did it. Shared with everyone and editable later. Daily targets for your child's age from the Australian 24-hour movement guidelines, a gentle afternoon nudge, and a 14-day chart in Insights. Outdoors and play now count in the calm-days comparison.

1.18.0 Screen time: quick minutes, a timer you can pause and resume, or a start and end time, by type (shows, games and apps, learning, video calls). Gentle in-app reminders as the day nears and passes the guideline for your child's age. Video calls aren't counted. 14-day chart and type split in Insights. Shared with everyone.

1.19.0 Refresh button in the header, and pull down from the top to refresh: checks for a new version, syncs, and updates the time and cards. Saved entries now say what time and day they were saved for. The 'Log a night wake-up now' button now uses the date and time you set on the form instead of always using right now. The 'no food logged since' note no longer shows in the evening or after bedtime.

1.20.0 Me/Time tab: a private parent check-in (how's your cup today, tough moments with what happened, what was going on, repair and copying), tips straight after each moment, and patterns including how your child's days line up. Care time moved inside it. Feedback button on every screen: parents save it to the shared log, others share it as a message.

1.21.0 Medicines: a shared daily plan (name, dose, times, days, or as needed) with one-tap Taken, Late and Missed on the Log tab, dose changes marked on charts, quick notes of effects you notice, and Insights patterns (doses taken, how days looked before and after a change, missed-dose days). Possible effects listed in official Australian consumer information are shown for common children's medicines, with sources. Records and shows patterns only; no advice.

1.21.1 Me/Time care time: your partner now appears automatically in 'Who is doing it?' (and when adding or editing time), so you can log what you know they did. The picker is always shown, with an 'Add someone' button for anyone else.

1.22.0 Tidier Log tab: cards fold to one summary line (tap to open), one Start a timer card for active play, outdoors, screen time and your private care time (several can run at once), a collapsed 'Might help' in the outlook. History shows the last 24 hours with a Show earlier button and shorter notes. Settings > What I track lets this phone hide cards, hide log areas it doesn't use, or keep cards open.

1.23.0 Today's outlook now notices what is carrying on from yesterday (a second short night, a run of bumpier days, sleep easing again) and varies its wording from day to day, in a gentle, no-guilt tone. Medicines can have a check or retest date (for example an iron retest): a countdown, a daily encouragement to keep the dose up, a kind count of days given, and an optional daily reminder file for your calendar.

1.24.0 New log areas: Lessons & sport (engagement, confidence, wants to go back), Kinder & school (where, how it went, pick-up mood, pick-up meltdown), Self-care skills, Tantrums (length, what came before, how it settled, afterwards), plus chips on Social. Quick taps for whining and 'said they don't love me'. Insights shows gentle patterns and ideas for each. More timer circumstances (bedtime routine, meals, playing together, pick-ups, meltdown support).

1.25.0 Bedtime routines (a usual one plus different ones for particular days or nights, timed steps with notes, ticking steps off or skipping them, a gentle 'now' line and still-to-do marking), a days-ahead plan (food, where things are, notes, medicines, appointments), shared appointments with repeats, reminders, an add-to-calendar file and a 'how did it go?' prompt that saves to the log, and carer questions and notes the parents can answer. Family members can be given the routine and plan, locked with their own key.

1.26.0 New Today tab: everything happening now (outlook, timers, routine, medicines, appointments, days ahead, outdoor play, screen time, quick taps) with the most useful one-tap action on each folded card and the most relevant cards first for the time of day. The Log tab is now just the form. A gold dot on Today shows when something needs you. A Getting set up list, plus People and carers, Share or export and Settings buttons, make everything easy to find. Export moved to a button in the header.

1.27.0 Time with people (who looked after them, played, one-on-one, stays at someone's place, with start and end; carers can log it too). How they ate: one tap for the day plus meals and snacks with how much was eaten. A Day breakdown timeline on Today, and a Day breakdown button on each day in History. The outlook no longer nags about unlogged food and now uses time with people gently. Today so far groups the day cards. Emoji replaced with one set of rounded line icons. Settings has jump links at the top.

1.28.0 New Today screen: Now (only what needs you), Log tiles, the day timeline, and Worth knowing. The Log tab is gone; each tile opens a short sheet or the log form and comes back to Today after saving. Choose and order your own tiles (saved per phone); everything else is under More. Medicines and supplements are one place, each marked as a medicine or a supplement. Eating notes link from Ate.

1.29.0 Slimmer log tiles: 11 of your choice plus More. Medicines and supplements can be filled in from saved supplements (name, amount, contents). Each can have backups, with a Gave backup button and an Out of stock switch. Supplements given from the plan are also logged as supplements, so nutrient totals include them; a backup with the same nutrient counts toward the retest.

1.30.0 Tile icons are colour coded by group (food and play, sleep and screens, mood and behaviour, health and medicines, people and wins), and tiles of a group sit together. Choose my tiles shows the groups and has a Keep colour groups together switch. The day timeline uses the same colours. Tantrum has its own icon.

1.31.0 One Medicines and supplements tile that asks Supplements or Medicine. As-needed medicines show time since the last dose and when the next can be given, using the gap and 24-hour limit you copy from the label. On sick days a strip at the top of Today shows dose timers, the last temperature, and a small chart of temperatures and doses with a + to add a reading. Doses and the Unwell tile ask what it is for; unwell days are flagged in History with a sick-day view, and Insights shows how often and what for. Medicines can hold a doctor's dose note, doses left with a running-low warning, and repeats. Settings now has a searchable Updates list, and a note appears after each update.

1.32.0 Food logging setting: Off, Simple or Detailed. Simple lets you tap what was in each meal and shows a rough picture by food group, with iron and calcium as a guide (including iron from supplements). Detailed lets foods hold nutrient amounts per serve and shows daily totals with supplements. No calories. New lunch box planner: set school days, breaks and days off; plan boxes the night before (with where things are, a note for whoever packs, and copying a previous day); tick items off while packing; after school rate how much of each item was eaten and what part was left, with optional photos that stay on the phone and are deleted once rated or after 7 days; ideas and a shopping list from what gets eaten. Older medicine plans with supplement names are now treated as supplements.

1.33.0 Cleaner Today screen: Worth knowing and the Day breakdown now fold up (tap to open), with their extra headings removed. Logging from a tile (like a one-off supplement) no longer shows the list of areas, just the form for that thing.

1.33.1 History opens on the last 48 hours, starting from the beginning of the earliest day shown (so today, yesterday and the day before, in full). Show earlier adds a week at a time. The Medicines and supplements tile label is back to how it was.
1.33.2 Everything logged with the Ate tile (the day's Low, Usual or Big, and each meal or snack with how much was eaten) and rated lunch boxes now show in History under Eating. Tap one to edit it.
1.33.3 In History, the day's Low, Usual or Big eating tap no longer shows the time it was tapped; it reads How they ate today. Meals show only at the meal time.
